items.question: Which deities and beings are enumerated in the tattva portions beginning with atman?
premises: Devayani and Shashthi are named in the list.
Vidya and the rooster are also named.
The list continues after Skanda and Vishakha.
items.inference: The verse extends the enumeration of tattva-associated deities and beings.
uncertainties: The exact grammatical gender of kukkuṭā is not fully certain from this isolated verse.
items.plain_english: Devayani, Shashthi, Vidya, and the rooster.
